level_id_bank.verdict: NOT HELD. Four ladders, all verified, and the operator's own drawing agrees with them at every level that matters: his olive band is floored on ladder C and centred on ladder B, his upper teal band rings a three-ladder knot, and his largest teal band is floored on a C/D hinge and drawn around the volume POC. The one place he draws independently -- the purple band, both edges non-rung -- is also the weakest by source count. Overhead, three ladders stack into 2,289-2,344 and his converging wedge resolves at 2,392.5, just above it: the drawing and the fib map name the same breakout.
